title: Personal Guest Certificate Renewal
description: POST /api/personal-guest/v1/bindings/{bindingId}/renewals uses the current pinned mTLS certificate and returns requestId, binding, certificatePEM and clientCAPEM and commitBefore. A durable requestId and identical CSR recover a lost response. POST /renewals/{requestId}/commit uses the pending new certificate; repeats recover a lost commit. Core rechecks current owner/access/provider identity on both steps. Only commit promotes binding version and certificate; heartbeat sequence is preserved. Expired pending requests return 410 only after authenticating the still-current certificate and owner. The client must verify the unchanged current binding before durably replacing its expired request ID. Expired certificates cannot renew. Duplicate keys, unknown fields and noncanonical casing are rejected. The new certificate grants liveness only, never data or execution readiness.
